reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: The visible core piece is a medium- to fine-grained, grey to light grey rock with white to pale grey patches. The rock shows a strongly foliated / banded fabric with alternating darker grey and lighter whitish-grey laminae, consistent with a foliated metamorphic rock such as a mica schist / paragneiss. Grain size is fine to medium in the photo resolution, with a mottled, inequigranular appearance and a wavy foliation.

anomalies.explanation: A single angular fracture / break is visible in the core with a small offset, the red orientation / depth line is continuous across the piece with a small mark at the break.
The leftmost end of the run shows a small amount of broken / irregular core material at the tray edge, with the main core piece starting just in from the left block.
